description: Techno-Economic Simulation Results Using dGeo for EGS-Based District Heating in the Northeastern United States is a data set deposited in DOE National Library of the Rockies (NLR) Repository by its authors Hannah Pauling. This dataset presents the results of techno-economic simulations performed using the Distributed Geothermal Market Demand Model (dGeo) to evaluate the feasibility of Enhanced Geothermal Systems (EGS)-based district heating in the Northeastern United States. Coverage: national (US); the metadata date the deposit to 2024. The formats are not stated in the metadata. Size stated: 2 files. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is not stated (no licence in the DataCite metadata read on 2026-09-29). Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related records: none catalogued yet for this repository.
